about: The doc fluidity budgets (docs programme A2, I20; G-PERF). scripts/fluidity/docs.mjs measures each metric on a production build against the fake server side (fakeApp.mjs, 150 ms a round trip, two more for a new socket's handshakes) and exits non-zero when an enforced value is over its max.

max is what a run must stay under now; target is where the metric must get to, and owner the package that gets it there. Where max is above target, max was measured on 12 Oct 2026 (with a margin for a shared machine) and only ever goes down.

enforce false: printed against its target, never failing the run, because on a shared machine the 2,000-block timings vary threefold with load. Enforce them on a quiet runner, or once their owner brings them under target.
Never raise a max to make a run pass. Lower it when a package brings a metric down.

20 Oct 2026 (FLUIDITY-LEAD, fluid-05): a paste of sixty paragraphs and a list (pasteMs) and the 2,000-block doc scrolled down and back (bigScrollFrameP95Ms). Keys at 4x: 50 ms p95 for a normal doc, 90 ms for the 2,000-block one (agreed with DOCS-LEAD; a ceiling C11 works toward 50).

network.why: The low end of the demo's time to first byte from here (155–814 ms, perf §1.1).

againEditableMs.source: PROGRAM A2: a second in-app open is editable in 200 ms at 1×, 400 ms at 4×

firstEditableMs.source: PROGRAM A2: a first in-app open is editable in 600 ms at 1×, 1,000 ms at 4×

firstEditableAfterBodyMs.source: perf 1.2: editable within 400 ms of the body showing

socketsPerTab.source: perf 1.1: one socket across every open in a tab

keyP95Ms.source: I20: key p95 32 ms at 1×, 50 ms at 4× in a normal doc

readerSeesTypingMs.source: PROGRAM A2: a viewer sees typing within 1 s

routeKbOverHome.source: I20: the doc route adds at most 300 KB gzip over Home (A1 makes doc-only blocks lazy); 445–449 KB on 12 Oct, 484 on 16 Oct (b17g); 433 on 16 Oct once table editing came with a doc's first table and an embedded table's grid with its first embed (3 of 4 runs; the fourth, at load 88, counted Home's own late chunks). Report only since 17 Oct (DOCS-LEAD): it counts the chunks fetched on idle inside a time window, 442 KB at 1× and 598 at 4× on one build; the doc route's weight is held from the build itself (route-ceilings.json, scripts/fluidity/routes.mjs)

bigLayoutReadsPerKey.source: I20: no layout read per key. 2 a key on 12 Oct, both the block handle's view update (getClientRects, getBoundingClientRect); 0 since B1 (14 Oct: the handle goes while you type and reads nothing). ProseMirror's own scroll of the caret into view is not counted

bigDispatchMsPerKey.source: perf 2.2: dispatch 8 ms a key on 2,000 blocks at 4×. A2 removed the two whole-doc walks (placeholder 1.7 ms, image offload 1.9 ms); y-prosemirror's sync view, which diffs the whole top-level fragment on every transaction, is 5.4–6.5 ms of the rest

bigKeyP95Ms.source: perf 2.2 and C11: key p95 on 2,000 blocks 32 ms at 1×, 90 ms at 4×

pasteMs.source: Sixty paragraphs and a list pasted into the plan until the last pasted line shows. Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 43 at 1x on a computer, 135 at 4x on a phone. Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun. Target: An edit committed and shown (optimistic, then saved): 100 ms on a computer, 300 ms on the 4x phone (the brief: optimistic updates for every edit)

bigScrollFrameP95Ms.source: Frame time p95 scrolling the 2,000-block doc down and back. Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 16.75 at 1x on a computer, 16.75 at 4x on a phone. Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun. Target: Frame time p95 while it scrolls or drags: one 60 Hz refresh (16.7 ms) on a computer, two (33.4 ms) on the 4x phone (the brief; 60 fps, never under 30)
